rules.prepare:
# As in Debian's rules, with these differences: no multiarch folders, and # the file for pkg-config is installed (--enable-pkgconfig, as in Alpine): # the one of utmps names libskarnet. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" ./tools/gen-deps.sh > package/deps.mak
CC="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" \ ./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --dynlibdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --libdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --includedir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include" \ --sysdepdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/skalibs/sysdeps" \ --disable-rpath \ --enable-pkgconfig
